mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers a contractionary monetary policy response, tightening financial conditions and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When demand growth (GDPC1) outpaces supply growth (INDPRO) by more than 2 percentage points monthly, it signals upward pressure on prices and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > INDPRO growth rate by >2 percentage points
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds INDPRO growth rate by >2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trajectory in the unemployment rate below 6.0% signals labor market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite UNRATE rising above 6.0% in the recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2%, it indicates aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST (household demand index) of over 5% above the prior month's level correlates with heightened consumer spending, driving up corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when HOUST increases by >5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand (RSAFS > 300k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%) create a favorable macro environment, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when RSAFS exceeds 300k and UNRATE is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When supply growth (INDPRO) outpaces demand growth (GDPC1) by 1 percentage point or more monthly, it signals potential market overhangs and reduced price pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate <= INDPRO growth rate by >=1 percentage point
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when GDPC1 growth rate is less than or equal to INDPRO growth rate by >=1 percentage point.
